question: Should this PR wait for a fresh repository-backed review rather than be merged from the supplied metadata alone?
rationale: Automation cannot safely give the final merge verdict without the mandatory local source, current-main, scoped-policy, and history inspection.

options.title: Require fresh review
options.body: Refresh the branch and rerun ClawSweeper or perform a maintainer review after the sandbox is healthy.

options.title: Accept metadata evidence
options.body: Merge from the focused supplied diff and passing GitHub checks despite the missing independent repository inspection.

recommendation.title: Require fresh review
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and rerun ClawSweeper or perform a maintainer review after the sandbox is healthy.

likelyOwner.reason: No evidence-backed named code owner could be established because repository history was inaccessible.
